the extracellular environment, in particular the presence or absence of LN and FN, has a major influence on the development of neuronal polarity.

neurite growth is a dynamic process in which the cell body and the neurites are constantly interacting.
the expression of neuronal differentiation and the formation of dendritic processes depend on the extracellular matrix proteins present in the environment of the growing neurites.
